example.title: St. Gabriel's Church (Roman Catholic), 4522 South Wallace Street

brief: Big Romanesque Revival brick church of 1887 for the Polish parish near the rail yards: a broad gabled front with a large rose window over three arched doors, a massive square corner tower with a pyramidal cap, round-arched side windows, and an ornate carved altar inside; the parish school stands alongside.
